name: Set Apart
overview: Scripture reveals that being set apart is a divine calling for believers to live as a holy and distinct people chosen by God, as seen in Deuteronomy 14:2 and Psalms 4:3. This consecration involves offering ourselves as living sacrifices, holy and acceptable to God, which Romans 12:1-2 explains requires a transformation through the renewing of the mind. Galatians 2:20 and Ephesians 2:10 further emphasize that this set-apart life is empowered by Christ living within us and is expressed through the good works God has prepared for us to walk in.
